title: feat(studio): the list-view panel switches between an object's list views, a drafted one included
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg3qmEgg8nuMvib7TEbgTTrq)_

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Studio › 界面 › 列表视图面板，对象有两个以上列表视图时，面板顶部多一个「视图」选择器，按名称列出该对象的全部列表视图（已发布的，加上本包里还没发布的草稿视图，标「草稿」）；选一个就在面板和画布上打开它的设置，改动自动保存到那个视图。
- 为什么改：用「添加视图」建好的视图，作者一离开就在 Studio 里再也打不开了，只能靠导航项指名它。
- 风险与回滚：只动 Studio 面板、宿主的切换守卫与两条 i18n；导航项不改，面板仍先打开导航项自己的视图；切换前先把未发出的修改发给原视图，发不出（被暂扣或被拒）就先问；整个 PR 回滚即恢复原状，无数据迁移。
- 先看：`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` 里的 `switchListView` 与紧随的 effect（冲刷后再切、暂扣先问）、`ObjectListViewInspector.tsx` 的 `listViewChoicesOf` 与草稿读取 effect、新测试文件。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.listViewSwitch-27896.test.tsx`，预期 5 passed。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Fixes #27896

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

- **A view picker in the list-view panel.** When the open object has more than one list view, the panel shows a "View" picker above "Add view". It lists the object's list views by label (the panel's own title spelling: the item's label, else "OBJECT · Default view" or "OBJECT · KEY"). A view drafted in this package and not yet published carries a "Draft" mark.
- **Where the list comes from.** Published views: the merged `listViews` map the shell's metadata already holds, the same map the panel resolves the nav entry's view from. Drafted views: this package's pending drafts of the object's list views, read once per object, package and publish through the pillar's existing `MetadataClient` with the drafts overlaid (`withPreviewDrafts(true).list('view', { packageId })`, keeping the `_draft` rows of this object), the read the Studio rail already uses for draft labels. A draft stands in for the published view of its name. "Add view" re-reads it, so a view made there is listed. A failed or refused read lists the published views alone. No new endpoint, client or metadata key.
- **A pick opens that view in the same buffer.** `useObjectListViewDraft` gains `showView(viewId)`; the picked view replaces the one "Add view" created in the hook's single "shown instead of the entry's view" slot, stamped with the nav entry, so it expires when another leaf opens. The panel, the canvas and the autosave then address the picked view; an edit saves to its draft under its own name. The nav entry's view is still the one the panel opens with, and the nav entry is not changed.
- **The switch goes through the pillar's guard.** The Interfaces pillar's `switchListView` (the panel's `onSwitchView`) sends a pending edit first with the list-view autosave's own `flush` and switches once the buffer is clean, waiting out a save in flight, as the Data pillar's object rail does. An edit that cannot be sent (held for a missing required setting, or refused with the refusal on screen) asks `confirmDropUnsavedWork` first; declined, the panel stays. "Back to …" now switches the same way (before, it dropped an edit still inside the debounce).
- **One view, no picker** (the card's control, option "no picker" chosen): a one-entry picker offers nothing to pick, and "Add view" is the way to make a second view. An entry view that does not exist yet (a default view no edit has created) is still listed first, so the author can return to it.
- **i18n (en, zh, new keys only):** `engine.studio.inspector.listView.switchView`, `engine.studio.inspector.listView.switchViewDraft`.

## Tests

`StudioDesignSurface.listViewSwitch-27896.test.tsx`: the mounted Interfaces pillar, its real list-view autosave and the real panel; the client is a recorder. The object has a published default grid, a published calendar and a calendar only drafted in this package.

- the picker lists all three by label, only the drafted one marked "Draft", and opens on the nav entry's view;
- picking the drafted view shows its settings, and an edit there saves to `showcase_task.mine` in the package draft, never to the entry's view;
- a pending edit is sent to its own view at the switch (well inside the 1.5 s debounce), the other view opens, and nothing asks;
- a held edit asks first: declined, the panel stays on that view with the held line and writes nothing; accepted, the other view opens and nothing is written;
- control: an object with one list view shows no picker.

<details><summary>Ablations (one-time, not kept)</summary>

Both through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on the committed head, test files resolved from source:

1. The host switch's flush (`listViewSaving || (listViewDirty && !listViewHolds && flushListView())` reduced to `listViewSaving`): anchor 1 to 0, blob `0275069e` to `309ac7ae`. **1 failed, 4 passed**: the pending-edit case (`expected [] to deeply equal [ 'showcase_task.due' ]`). Restored: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
2. The draft read's `_draft` filter replaced by `false`: anchor 1 to 0, blob `f46d63b6` to `86dd604b`. **2 failed, 3 passed**: the listing case (`[ 'All tasks', 'Due dates' ]`) and the drafted-view case. Restored: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **The drafted-view read is the overlaid list, not the draft headers.** `listDrafts` serves names only (no object, no label), so listing a draft by label from it would cost one read per draft. The overlaid list is one read, through the same client the pillar already holds.
- **Views drafted in another package are not listed**: the read is scoped to this package, as every write here is. A published view of the object is listed whichever package published it.
- **The list is read when the object opens, after a publish, and after "Add view"**, not live: a view drafted meanwhile elsewhere (another tab, the copilot) appears once the leaf is opened again.
- **The confirm asks on the list-view buffer's dirty flag** once the flush could not send, which is `heldUnsent`'s list-view half plus a refused save; the leaf's own held edit (`leafHeld`) belongs to another buffer that a view switch does not touch.
